visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Comparing Against the Consumed Number
visualizerParams.problemDescription: 121 reads the same backwards, but the program says false for every number.

solution.explanation: The loop divides n down to 0, so after it n no longer holds the number. Comparing 0 with the reversed number is false for every input. Keep a copy of the original value and compare against that.
